# Hosted report queue region

Status: region selected; implementation deferred by request

## Choice

Configure the hosted report queue with `eu-west-1` before use. The jobs carry
each shop's customer list. Of the offered regions (`us-east-1`, `eu-west-1`),
this choice follows example/mira-decisions ADR 0007, referenced below.

Mira delegated this task's choice: "Pick whichever you think is right."
This delegation applies to this region selection only.

## Ruling reference

Reference
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0007
  Path           docs/adr/0007-customer-data-stays-in-the-eu.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:76d4ddd957775272a8f878502143e22be3c7f5c8851eac6828c35a046439a810

Verified against the local clone's origin
`https://github.com/example/mira-decisions.git`. The cited file's SHA-256
matches. Its status is Accepted at the cited commit and at the checked HEAD,
which is the same commit.

## Open item

ADR 0024 is reserved for Mira's additional cross-product logging ruling in
the task message dated 2026-10-22. Recording it remains blocked: the read-adr
skill requires the kc-dev-flow-2 ADR template and linter, but that package
is absent from the installed locations. Its writing instructions say to stop
when the package cannot be resolved. Install the required writing tools,
then record and lint ADR 0024 using Mira's original words and full scope.

No queue configuration or feature code has been changed.
